  Finset.induction_on (motive := fun s ↦
    (∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0) → Roth.index (∏ i ∈ s, f i) α r = ∑ i ∈ s, Roth.index (f i) α r) s
    (fun hf ↦
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ Roth.index _a α r = ∑ i ∈ ∅, Roth.index (f i) α r) Finset.prod_empty))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ Roth.index 1 α r = _a) Finset.sum_empty))

            (of_eq_true

        (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ Roth.index _a α r = ∑ i ∈ insert a s, Roth.index (f i) α r) (Finset.prod_insert has)))
